# TildaZ v0.6.1

**Corrected Linux packages and complete Shell integration.**

v0.6.1 replaces the Linux packages published with v0.6.0. The Arch package
installed a desktop entry whose executable placeholder was never resolved, and
the portable archives looked for their icon in the source repository instead
of inside the extracted bundle. Other v0.6.0 Linux package formats launched,
but none carried the GNOME or Cinnamon extensions required for a true
drop-down on those desktops. ([#279](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/279),
[#280](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/280))

## Linux package fixes

- Arch packages now install `Exec=/usr/bin/tildaz` instead of the unresolved
  `__TILDAZ_EXE__` template value.
- Portable tarballs use their bundled icon and can be installed after
  extraction anywhere on the filesystem.
- Desktop entry generation is shared by deb, rpm, and Arch packages. Packaging
  now fails if the final entry contains a placeholder or an unexpected
  executable path.
- Portable archives are unpacked and installed into an isolated home directory
  during packaging, so the actual end-user install path is verified.

## GNOME and Cinnamon

- Every Linux package now includes the GNOME and Cinnamon Shell extension
  resources.
- System packages and AppImages keep those resources under `share/tildaz`.
  On GNOME or Cinnamon, TildaZ synchronizes the matching extension into the
  current user's extension directory and enables it from the user session.
- Package installation never modifies another user's desktop settings.
- Concurrent numbered workers compile the GNOME schema in separate temporary
  directories and atomically publish the completed schema cache.

Linux packages from v0.6.0 should be replaced with v0.6.1. The macOS and
Windows behavior is unchanged; their artifacts are rebuilt with the v0.6.1
version metadata.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.6.1-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.6.1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.6.1-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.6.1-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.6.1-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 14+ universal | `tildaz-v0.6.1-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; ad-hoc signed. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.6.1-win-x64.zip` | Includes the bundled ConPTY runtime. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.6.1-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary and ConPTY runtime. |
